newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss vote to maintain arms exports.
newsitem.headline: Swiss vote to maintain arms exports.

text.p: Switzerland voted in a referendum on Sunday to maintain its export of arms to other countries, overwhelmingly rejecting an effort by left-wing and Green parties to have the lucrative trade banned.

Swiss voters also turned down a proposal by right-wing groups which wanted to tie the government's hands in negotiations with the European Union by making it compulsory for any proposals to be approved by the people in advance.
Returns in from most of the country's 26 cantons showed nearly 80 per cent of the turnout voting against a ban on exporting arms, which opponents said could have led to the loss of nearly 6,000 jobs.

Opposition to the EU measure, which its supporters billed as the "let the people decide" initiative, was running at nearly 73 per cent of the turnout -- itself only around 33 per cent of the registered electorate.
